# artifactory_repository_excludes (Resource)

Manages a subset of the `excludes_pattern` of an existing repository, without managing the repository itself. Useful to block specific packages or images (e.g. a Docker `image:tag`) declaratively.

~>Do not use this resource together with the `excludes_pattern` attribute on the repository resource for the same repository, as they will conflict. Use `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [excludes_pattern] }` on the repository resource if it is also managed by Terraform.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "artifactory_repository_excludes" "blocked-images" {
  repo_key = "my-docker-remote"
  patterns = [
    "library/nginx/1.21.0/**",
    "library/alpine/3.14.0/**",
  ]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `patterns` (Set of String) Set of Ant-style path patterns to add to the repository's `excludes_pattern`, e.g. `my-image/1.0.0/**` to block a Docker image tag. Patterns not managed by this resource are left untouched.
- `repo_key` (String) Repository key.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import artifactory_repository_excludes.blocked-images my-docker-remote
```
